heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (log viewer): inspect view starts a local server on port 8080 by default.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (caching): with cache = True, cached model responses expire after 1 day.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (deep agents): background dispatch caps concurrently running background agents at 4.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (compaction): if the context window is unknown, a default of 32,000 tokens is assumed.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (log files): to override the default ./logs log directory, set the environment variable INSPECT_LOGS_PATH.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (epochs): by default, epoch scores are combined into one score with the mode reducer.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (eval sets): the default retry wait between attempts is 10 seconds.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (model grading): the built-in model-graded scorers look for the judge model role by default.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (models): set the environment variable INSPECT_MODEL to select the model so you do not need to pass --model.

heading: Team wiki (2023)
text: Team wiki, 2023 (standard tools): the bash and python tool example uses a 10 minute timeout.
